Wireshark Lua dissectors for Firedancer Tango, TPU, shred, and related message formats.

# Purpose
This Lua file defines a set of Wireshark dissectors for Firedancer and Solana-related message formats. The main protocol is `fd_tango`, which parses Tango fragment packets, reads the header fields, decodes control bits, and uses the last 4 bytes as a link hash to identify the message path. It then selects a follow-on dissector based on the link name and decodes the payload as Ethernet frames, Solana transaction metadata, PoH-to-shred data, shred store data, leader-change data, rebate data, or packing-complete data. The file also registers the Solana TPU UDP dissector on UDP port `9001`.

The file also defines several helper protocols and parsers for nested data structures. These include `fd_txn_t` for transaction layout data, `fd_poh_shred` for PoH-to-shred messages, `fd_pack_rebate_t` for CU rebate records, `fd_shred34_t` for shred batches, `fd_became_leader_t` for leader transition records, `fd_done_packing_t` for packing completion records, and `fd_txn_m_t` for transaction records with payload and metadata. Each dissector adds typed fields to the Wireshark tree and, where needed, calls other dissectors to decode embedded Solana transaction data or shred data.
